summary.headline: Astrological Judgments on Children
summary.text: Astrological judgments on fertility and offspring: the part of children, fifth house, its lord, benefics and malefics, luminaries, aspects, retrogradation, combustion, detriment, fall, and cadency are used to predict many or few children, sterility, harmony, and children’s deaths. Chapter XXI begins, concerning the timing of children.
